title: Paid clones on skip-prefix strips: conditional κ = 4.529040672e-5
body:
This improves the conditional exponent from PR #53 by **0.686876%**, and from PR #36 by **17.769260%**:

$$
T(n)=O\left(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\right),\qquad
\kappa=\frac{141532521}{3125000000000}=4.529040672\times10^{-5}>2^{-15}.
$$

The result remains conditional on OpenAI's base theorem and the inherited analytic and fixed finite-alphabet multitape interfaces.

## Construction

Starting from PR #53's skip-prefix graphs, add **253 whole-chain clones at h=23** and **353 at h=25**. Each added gate recomputes an existing scalar sum from disjoint sources and replaces one complete continuation chain. Two previously unused carrier capacities retain its inputs. All **606 added gates and 1,212 added carrier links are included in the cost**.

| Quantity | PR #53 | This PR |
|---|---:|---:|
| Roles at h=23 | 32,946 | 32,693 |
| Roles at h=25 | 43,409 | 43,056 |
| Physical wires W | 160,799,739 | 159,592,676 |

Every clone retains its parent's original core/cover envelope. The common I+J bases, all 4,073,300 data pairs, copied centers, paid endpoint corrections, complex network and assembly interfaces remain unchanged. The exact bit saving is `1132311451/25000000000000`.

This branch builds on #53 at `3ffd4021995c959ac02d12920e0279ae97dd03c7`. The new implementation and proof are in `research/skip-clones/`.

## Verification

Completed on the published construction:

- Exact scalar identities, dense global supports and independent recount of every selected carrier use.
- Fresh fixed-profile CRT replay and complete dirty-scratch basis checks in both orientations.
- Exact rational moment bounds, next-grid rejection, 47 strict assembly constraints and seven positive margins.
- **11 focused tests** and **65 adversarial rejection cases**, including malformed partitions, partial chains, provider collisions, invalid counts and stale source pins.

**Latest main (`d55bcd6`) is integrated at `1d1bb12`.** Fresh `make -j1 verify-research verify-skip verify-tests` passed: **28 recovered research audits**, complete PR #53/#54 producer replays, **20 + 11 focused tests**, **450 integrated tests**, and **20 historical patch checks**. Regeneration was byte-clean. All 152 upstream-added files, all 239 pinned source entries, and the numerical certificate are unchanged. Both the new upstream research CI group and the existing skip CI group remain, across Python 3.11/3.13/3.14, with both formal jobs preserved. The [integration receipt](https://github.com/chafreaky/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1d1bb12d4ded9986c7fc064d1e805d856a6d35e6/research/skip-clones/validation.json) distinguishes these fresh scoped checks from prior complete runs.

The earlier full `make verify` passed after integrating main `64ed4cb`, at tested merge `03aff8b`: **277 integrated tests**, all focused and complete producer replays, and **20 historical patch checks**, with byte-identical regeneration. An independent review confirmed preserved main checks, credits, and numerical certificates. That full-run record remains intact; no fresh full-suite or local Lean result is claimed for the latest integration. All **23 GitHub CI jobs passed** on `1d1bb12` ([run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/37821249365)): all seven Python groups on three versions, plus both inherited formal packages.

The original construction also passed its full suite at `7210de7` (218 integrated tests and 18 patch checks).

```sh
make skip-clones-verify
make verify
```

[The local proof](https://github.com/chafreaky/integer-mult-bounds/blob/84eb0b067741dc2690da837743fda06d133da865/research/skip-clones/PROOF.md) states the argument and the inherited obligations requiring expert review. This is not a Lean proof or a claim of global optimality.
